phase: final validation after robust multi-opponent tuning
development: Initial 13-weight tune and diagnostics revealed opponent/board overfitting. Robust stage fixes ordering weights and tunes 5 static-evaluation weights vs original4/incumbent4/greedy; 6 generations x8 candidates, seed20261040.

adoption.primary: paired mean score >0.5 with one-sided z=2.394 (Bonferroni alpha=.05/6)
adoption.secondary: vs greedy, candidate observed score >= original observed score on matched seeds; report paired difference CI without formal non-inferiority claim
adoption.otherwise: retain original 4-ply parameters on that board
adoption.note: Pre-specified board-wise tests; report all boards, including rejected ones. Candidate aggregate rate is not the rate of a routed deployed policy.

note: Written before robust tuning finishes and before any final-validation game. Final seeds are not used for training/selection.
